title: ADI Forge Data Use Terms
body:
These terms explain how ADI-Labs ("we", "us") uses information about you when you take part on ADI Forge. They work together with the ADI Forge Contributor Terms and the Confidentiality and IP Terms.

1. Information we hold about you
- Profile details: first and last name, email address, LinkedIn profile link, and the CV you or a recruitment agency provide.
- Recruiter information: the assessment a recruitment agency sends us about your fit for a project, and which agency submitted you.
- Account details: how you sign in (Google sign-in or email and password; we store passwords only in protected, hashed form), and your acceptance of these terms.
- Work records: tasks assigned to you, what you author or review, comments, decisions on your work, and dates.
- Activity records: a log of actions on the platform (for example sign-ins, submissions and approvals), kept for security and audit.

We do not collect or store identity documents, photos of identity documents, or government ID numbers.

2. How we use it
- to assign you tasks that match your skills, and to manage projects;
- to review, approve and pay attention to the quality of your work;
- to run, secure and improve ADI Forge;
- to keep a reliable record of who did what, for audit and quality purposes;
- to contact you about your assignments and these terms.

3. Automated tools
ADI Forge includes AI tools, such as the in-task Help assistant, that may process your messages and task content to give you guidance. These tools never make decisions about you: assignments, approvals, rework and rejections are always made by a person.

4. Your work and training data
Approved tasks become part of a dataset used to train and evaluate AI systems, including in our RL Gym environment. Task content is synthetic, so it should contain no personal data. Your name and email are not included in exported tasks; an internal identifier links each task to its author for audit only.

5. Sharing
We share your information only:
- with service providers who host and run ADI Forge for us (for example cloud hosting and email delivery), under contract and only for that purpose;
- with the recruitment agency that submitted you, about the status of your assignment;
- where the law requires it.
We do not sell your information.

6. How long we keep it
We keep your profile and account details while you take part and for [retention period] afterwards. Work records, activity records and approved tasks are kept permanently, because they form a tamper-evident audit record that cannot be edited or deleted.

7. Your choices
You may ask to see, correct or delete your profile information, or to stop taking part, by writing to admin@adi-labs.ai. We will remove or anonymise what we can; records that must stay in the permanent audit record will be kept, but no longer used to contact you.

8. Security
Data is stored in secured cloud services with access limited to people who need it for their role.

9. Changes
We may update these terms; you will be asked to accept the new version before your next assignment.

Questions: admin@adi-labs.ai

By selecting "I accept", you confirm you have read and agree to these terms.
